n8f625edf06.headline: How much money the Pension Fund received from customs clearance of “euro plates”: amount
n8f625edf06.summary: The Ukrainian Pension Fund collected 5.58 billion hryvnias from customs clearance fees on cars with euro plates, with 4.71 billion hryvnias collected in 2019.
n8f625edf06.why: Customs revenues contribute to social security funding and fiscal resources in Ukraine.
